tools.name: papierkram_get_info
tools.description: Read the API version and the account's custom invoice templates (ids usable as custom_template_id when creating an invoice).

tools.name: papierkram_list_companies
tools.description: List contacts (companies: customers and suppliers) with address, VAT id and contact data. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_company
tools.description: Get one contact (company) by id, with its people.

tools.name: papierkram_list_persons
tools.description: List the contact persons of one company. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_person
tools.description: Get one contact person of a company.

tools.name: papierkram_list_invoices
tools.description: List outgoing invoices (Ausgangsrechnungen) with state (draft, ...), dates, totals and outstanding_amount. Filter by company, project or document date range. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one outgoing invoice with its line items, billing address and payment term.

tools.name: papierkram_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates (Angebote) with state, dates and totals. Filter by company, project or document date range. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_estimate
tools.description: Get one estimate with its line items.

tools.name: papierkram_list_vouchers
tools.description: List expense vouchers (Belege / incoming invoices and receipts) with creditor, state, dates and amounts. Filter by creditor (supplier company), project or document date range. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_voucher
tools.description: Get one expense voucher with its line items.

tools.name: papierkram_list_payment_terms
tools.description: List the payment term templates (ids needed as payment_term_id when creating an invoice).

tools.name: papierkram_list_propositions
tools.description: List the stored products and services (Leistungen/Artikel) with article number, price and unit (the VAT rate is only in papierkram_get_proposition). Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_proposition
tools.description: Get one stored product or service, including its vat_rate (name such as 19% and rate such as 0.19).

tools.name: papierkram_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with dates, budget and state. Filter by company. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id.

tools.name: papierkram_list_tasks
tools.description: List time-tracking tasks. Filter by project or product/service. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id.

tools.name: papierkram_list_time_entries
tools.description: List tracked time entries. Filter by project, task, invoice, user, billing state or start time range (RFC 3339 date-time). Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_time_entry
tools.description: Get one time entry by id.

tools.name: papierkram_list_bank_connections
tools.description: List the bank accounts connected to Papierkram (name, IBAN, balance data as Papierkram reports it). Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_list_bank_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions (value, currency, usage text, booking date, counterparty). Filter by bank connection. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_bank_transaction
tools.description: Get one bank transaction by id.

tools.name: papierkram_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the account (ids needed as user_id for time entries and tasks).

tools.name: papierkram_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id.

tools.name: papierkram_create_company
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact (company) in Papierkram. Papierkram assigns the customer number. Nothing is sent to the contact. Check papierkram_list_companies first to avoid duplicates. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

tools.name: papierkram_update_company
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact (only the fields you pass are changed). Read it first with papierkram_get_company.

tools.name: papierkram_create_person
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact person to an existing company. Nothing is sent to the person. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

tools.name: papierkram_create_project
tools.description: WRITE: create a project for a customer. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

tools.name: papierkram_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a time-tracking task in a project. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

tools.name: papierkram_create_time_entry
tools.description: WRITE: record a time entry (worked time) on a task. Not billed until an invoice is made. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

tools.name: papierkram_create_proposition
tools.description: WRITE: create a stored product or service (Leistung/Artikel) with a price. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

tools.name: papierkram_create_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT outgoing invoice (state draft; it is NOT finalized or sent, and gets no invoice number until the user completes it in Papierkram). Needs a payment term id (papierkram_list_payment_terms) and at least one line item. Use papierkram_list_invoices afterwards to check it. Costs Papi
